author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
This QuickBooks Online tutorial for 2026 shows you how to categorize transactions for a full month of real business activity, from AI suggestions to bank rules to receipts.
🌎 Get access to QuickBooks Online ➜ https://quickbooks.kevinstratvert.com/

First, you'll get your bank and credit card transactions into QuickBooks Online, either by linking your bank or by uploading a CSV file.

Next, you'll see how QuickBooks AI suggests a category for each transaction, and how to read its confidence signals so you know which suggestions to trust and which to check.

Then, you'll handle credit card payments, transfers between your own accounts, and invoice payments, so nothing gets counted twice.

Afterward, you'll categorize transactions in QuickBooks Online that the AI can't figure out, split one charge across two categories, and move personal charges out of your business expenses.

After that, you'll set up bank rules that categorize recurring transactions for you, plus a simple naming system
title: How to Categorize Transactions in QuickBooks Online (2026)
